exposure: mode of delivery (vaginal delivery under epidural analgesia vs. cesarean section)
Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery under EA vs. CS)
cohort: 12 consecutive patients diagnosed with moyamoya disease who gave birth
finding: Vaginal delivery under epidural analgesia appears to be a safe option for patients with moyamoya disease, as no intrapartum strokes were observed in this study.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery with epidural analgesia may be an option for patients with moyamoya disease, as long as there is close collaboration between neurosurgeons, obstetricians, and anesthesiologists.
